definition: to toss a coin to let chance decide
description: In a narrow old town street with balconies, a young woman in a white T-shirt, work trousers and fingerless gloves catches a coin she has tossed into the air, then holds it up between her fingers and looks at it with a small smile. Beside her a bearded man in navy overalls leans with his arms folded against an upright piano on a hand trolley, wrapped in a moving blanket, and then bends to the trolley. Neighbours watch from balconies and a doorway, and a man on a scooter waits behind.

taps.phrase: to catch a coin in mid-air
